### How to Get Strong in God
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/how-to-get-strong-in-god
Passage: 1 Samuel 30:6
Points:
- David faced overwhelming distress when his own men blamed him and spoke of stoning him.
- Earlier in his journey, Jonathan had strengthened David's hand by speaking God's promises to him.
- In the crisis at Ziklag, David did for himself what Jonathan had previously done.
- Strengthening oneself in God occurs by meditating on and believing the Lord's spoken promises.
- Believers can find courage in distress by feeding their souls on God's promises fulfilled in Christ.

### Encouraging Ourselves through Tough Times
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/encouraging-ourselves-through-tough-times-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 30:6
Points:
- Experiencing hostility or feeling abandoned by others forces us to look directly to God.
- Overreliance on other people leaves us vulnerable and helpless when trials leave us isolated.
- Reading Scripture renews our strength with enduring divine promises.
- Recalling God's past miracles and faithfulness provides hope during dark seasons.
- Drawing close to God in prayer and worship restores and refreshes our souls.
